assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent character-group illustration for Pokémon Encounters tabletop cards and a brief ability cut-in.

Primary request: Create a new, polished illustration of the classic Team Rocket trio — Jessie (武藏), James (小次郎), and Meowth (喵喵). Match their recognizable original Pokémon anime character designs and clean 2D cel-shaded appearance.

Input image: The existing official Team Rocket image is an identity and drawing-style reference only. Do not preserve its landscape layout, teal background, or Wobbuffet. This is a new illustration rather than a recoloring of the old image.

Subject:
Jessie has long swept-back magenta-red hair, green earrings, a white cropped Team Rocket uniform, a black undershirt, white skirt, black gloves, and tall black boots.
James has a short lavender bob, a white Team Rocket uniform with long white trousers, black gloves, and black boots.
Meowth is a small cream-colored cat with a gold forehead coin, large eyes, cheek whiskers, small fangs, and a curled brown tail.
Preserve the familiar red R chest emblems as part of the costumes.

Composition: Portrait 4:5 canvas. Jessie and James stand together in a confident, playful Team Rocket pose; Meowth occupies the foreground between them. Keep all three full bodies, hair, hands, boots, ears, whiskers, and tail visible. Arrange the figures as a compact group filling approximately 80% of the canvas, with at least 8% clear safety margin around the full silhouette. Faces remain distinct and readable when reduced to a small game card.

Style: Precise dark anime outlines, vivid original character colors, restrained cel shading, crisp silhouette and clean edges. No 3D, realism, painterly texture, redesign, or chibi proportions.

Background: Genuinely transparent alpha. No opaque backdrop, ground plane, card frame, decorative effects, smoke, flames, speed lines, or oversized glow.

Constraints: Exactly these three characters. No other characters, speech bubbles, headline, score, numbers, UI, watermark, or additional text. Card borders, names, values, and animated effects will be supplied by code.

references.role: submitted identity and original 2D anime drawing-style reference; not an edit target; landscape composition, background and Wobbuffet excluded
